notes.title: 2017-05-20 - New Game Mode
notes.notes:
Hey folks! I've added a new game mode, "Hunters". In this game mode, the blocks hunt you down a bit, so you never get a moment to catch your breath. No achievement yet, as I'm trying to find a point that's difficult, but actually achievable. My best right now is 202... And to do it, I actually had to dodge-roll, which I don't think I've ever actually done in real life before.

I've also added various bugfixes.

notes.title: 2017-05-01 Update - Use your own music
notes.notes:
Hey folks, thanks for all the support, feedback, and the great user reviews! Some people really like the music in the game, others don't dig it, and that's to be expected.

In the settings I've added an option to use the music in your computer's music library. It'll search all the folders for MP3s so that you can get hit in the face with the tunes of your choosing.

notes.title: Into Early Access!
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone for being so patient as I've gotten things out into early access. Hopefully this will let me focus less on writing game descriptions (which can be surprisingly challenging) and more on making the game better. Initial reactions have been pretty positive, so I'm hoping to take constructive feedback and see what I can do to give the game a broader and more lasting appeal.

Have fun out there... And don't get hit in the face. ːsteamhappyː
